body.statement:
For every \(P\in\mathcal M_{\mathrm{ASC}}\) with observed law \(p=p(P)\), the displayed cell contrasts identify the selected-complier submeasures.  The capacity formulas give valid marginal outer bounds, while \(\underline\Delta(t;p)\) and \(\overline\Delta(t;p)\) are the separate same-law infimum and supremum over \(\mathcal F(p)\), attained by \(P_t^-(p)\) and \(P_t^+(p)\).  Moreover
\[
 \Theta_{\mathrm{ASC}}(p)
 \subseteq
 \prod_{t\in\mathcal T}
 [\underline\Delta(t;p),\overline\Delta(t;p)],
\]
with no rectangle-equality claim.  For the tangent conclusion, fix \(P_0\in\mathcal M_{\mathrm{ASC}}\), set \(p_0=p(P_0)\), and suppose
\[
 p_0\in\operatorname{relint}(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{ASC}}),
 \qquad
 \operatorname{im}(B)\subseteq\operatorname{lin}(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{ASC}}-p_0).
\]
For rational \((p_0,B)\), the compatible-direction lift proves that freezing nonzero base signs and retaining the active cuts \(\alpha_\psi'Bu\) yields closed rational cells \(P_{v,b}^0\) covering \(\mathbb R^d\), covariance \(\Sigma_0=\{B'\operatorname{diag}(p_0)^{-1}B\}^{-1}\), a certified nonempty separated domain, and a sample-size-free \(\mathfrak G_0\in\mathfrak E\).  No vector \(p_0+Bu\) is treated as a probability law.
body.justification: The theorem now uses the identical observed base \(p_0=p(P_0)\), preserves same-law endpoint semantics, and separates causal identification from tangent-domain conditions.
body.gap: The endpoint layer is established; final attachment of the fan conclusion awaits adjudication of the new relative-domain assumptions.
body.consumer: The Job Corps workflow may report coordinatewise endpoint labels while retaining the nonrectangular joint identified set.

obligation.what_is_open: Close the corrected fan membership conclusion at the identified base \(p_0=p(P_0)\) after the local-neighborhood, cover, and radius nodes are adjudicated.
obligation.obstruction: The same-law endpoint claims are proved, but the frozen theorem used an unrelated \(p_0\), and a compatible base alone does not imply feasibility in every tangent direction.
obligation.attempted: Fiber equivalence, coordinatewise endpoint attainment, and the joint-set outer rectangle are complete; the claim was narrowed only in its local-fan hypotheses.
obligation.partial_result:
The proved fiber equivalence and endpoint-attainment propositions imply
\[
 \Theta_{\mathrm{ASC}}(p)
 \subseteq\prod_{t\in\mathcal T}
 [\underline\Delta(t;p),\overline\Delta(t;p)],
\]
and each coordinate endpoint is attained by a single compatible law, separately for that endpoint.  This is an outer rectangle for the joint vector, not a rectangle-equality claim.  The remaining fan conclusion requires identifying the fan base with \(p(P_0)\) and ensuring that every direction of \(B\) has a local compatible-law neighborhood.
